description.zh:
组件ID，例如：nginx-ingress-controller、flexvolume、metrics-server。

集群支持的组件，可通过API `DescribeAddons` 进行查询。
description.en:
The component ID, such as nginx-ingress-controller, flexvolume, or metrics-server.

You can call the DescribeAddons API operation to query the components supported by a cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-cluster-addon-upgrade-status --cluster-id c106f377e16f34eb1808d6b9362c90000 --component-id cloud-controller-manager --region cn-hangzhou
